name: Attendo AB (publ)
summary: Attendo AB (publ) provides health and care services in Scandinavia and Finland. The company offers nursing homes for people with dementia or somatic care requirements; home care services, including care, meals, cleaning, laundry, evening and night, and home health care services; and homes for people of various ages with a range of disabilities or care needs. It also provides day care, respite care and companion, meal and staffing services, as well as short term accommodation; personalized residential care for people with neuropsychiatric and psychosocial disorders; and runs family homes, crisis and emergency homes, HVB homes, dependency care, schools, and various forms of supportive housing.…
